Assumption: The customer provides an OIDC identity provider with role claims
Travel times come from a commercial routing API the customer licenses
Technicians use company-managed Android or iOS phones
The CRM exposes ticket events or a REST API for new tickets
An SMS gateway account is provided by the customer
Van stock is held in a system with an update API
Billing accepts a daily batch file of completed jobs
Dashboards read from the operations database; no data warehouse in scope
